practices.title: Build an evidence-classification map
taskSequence: Extract each statement from the supplied synthetic learning scenario.
Classify each statement as observation, report, inference or unknown.
Attach the relevant source and uncertainty boundary.
Review the map for any inference that was promoted into fact.
selfCheckPrompts: Can every observation be traced to a directly available signal?
Are reports still attributed and are inferences still labelled?
practices.scenarioBoundary: Use only the synthetic Example and Case Study bound to this Lesson; the artifact is not Reality Evidence.

practices.title: Form a bounded Reading
taskSequence: State the time and evidence boundary of the synthetic scenario.
Form claims proportionate to the available observations and reports.
List plausible alternative explanations and missing information.
Write a boundary statement describing what the Reading cannot determine.
selfCheckPrompts: Does any claim exceed the evidence available in the scenario?
Are competing interpretations and unknowns visible?
Does the Reading avoid diagnosis and professional judgment?
practices.scenarioBoundary: The practice forms a learning artifact from synthetic content and cannot diagnose or determine a real situation.

practices.title: Map options without selecting an action
taskSequence: State the synthetic current position, goal and time boundary.
Map each available option together with material constraints.
Identify the authority required to choose or act on each option.
Define a review condition without selecting an option.
selfCheckPrompts: Was the current position stated before direction was considered?
Are constraints paired with the options they affect?
Has choice remained with the authorized decision-maker?
practices.scenarioBoundary: Navigation practice maps synthetic possibilities only; it neither recommends nor executes a real-world action.

practices.title: Form a traceable continuation state
taskSequence: Identify the synthetic action and the outcomes observed after it.
Separate outcome observations from causal interpretations.
Preserve unresolved uncertainty and prior decision lineage.
Form a bounded next review state without rewriting the earlier record.
selfCheckPrompts: Are action and outcome linked without claiming unproven causality?
Does the continuation preserve mixed results and unresolved uncertainty?
Was prior lineage retained rather than replaced?
practices.scenarioBoundary: The practice models continuity in a synthetic scenario and does not create Runtime Memory or a real continuation decision.

practices.title: Separate learning formation from professional authority
taskSequence: Identify the learning, capability, credential, entitlement and assignment states in the synthetic scenario.
Name the distinct authority responsible for resolving each state.
Mark every unresolved jurisdiction, verification and responsibility gate.
Write a boundary statement that prevents learning completion from becoming professional permission.
selfCheckPrompts: Are learning completion and Capability State still distinct?
Are Credential, Entitlement and accepted assignment independently governed?
Does the artifact avoid granting professional authority?
practices.scenarioBoundary: The practice is educational only and cannot verify, grant or recommend Credential, Entitlement, assignment or Professional authority.
